title: Seahawks plan a heavy workload for rookie RB Jadarian Price, maybe including kick returns

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Seahawks plan a heavy workload for rookie RB Jadarian Price, maybe including kick returns
sources.description: When the Seahawks' rookies reported to training camp on Friday, the highest-profile player in the group was first-round running back Jadarian Price, who projects to have a very big role as a rookie.
